commits.message:
fix(traceback): a location wider than the report folds instead of cropping (rich-traceback-igzo) (#279)

* fix(traceback): a location wider than the report folds instead of cropping (rich-traceback-igzo)

Traceback wrote bare segments, so Console cropped each line at the edge and
a frame under a long checkout path lost its file name and line number. The
report is now one RichText, fitted to the width the way every text is: long
lines wrap and an unbreakable location folds, as Rich's does.

crash-order's assertion now checks the fixture's full URL with line folds
removed, so it holds at any checkout path length.

* fix(traceback): a wrapped frame continues under itself; a non-string message is reported, not thrown (rich-traceback-igzo)

Review (high) of #279: the frame list is a block set two cells in, divided
by Padding's layoutPadding, so a location that wraps stays under its frame
instead of landing at column 0. toError's gate also requires name and message
to be strings, so a native error with message = undefined reaches the report
as a NonError instead of throwing inside the crash handler. The crash-order
assertion decodes ANSI before rejoining a fold.
